source: Istat, rilevazione "Iscritti in anagrafe per nascita" (Conta nomi)
measure: babies registered in Italy with the name, 1999–2025
notes: Years in which a name has fewer than 5 births are left out, as ISTAT's own counter shows them as "<5"; n adds up the years kept. Names ISTAT writes with an apostrophe (a final accent: Nicolò, Giosuè) cannot be looked up and are absent. ISTAT does not correct spelling or sex errors in the registers. The third value of last is the % of that sex's births that year.
